name: claude-wiki-skill
description: Read and maintain repository wikis in ChatGPT through GitHub.

interface.shortDescription: Read, edit and maintain project wikis.
interface.longDescription: Read authorized GitHub repository wikis with source links, edit knowledge, manage page protection, and save direct commits or reviewable pull requests. Requires a separately connected GitHub integration with permissions appropriate to the task.
defaultPrompt: Read my repository wiki and help me update its documentation.
